degree_rationale: Hyle as Enthumesis of Death — how she molded cosmos from herself, by her own thought-substance, the dark counterpart to the celestial Father. Treats the essence of evil's self-genesis.
direction_rationale: Inward processing of how darkness 'thinks' itself into form — the Enthumesis as receiving-faculty in the dark side, mirroring the celestial intellect. Reflective-comparative.
grand_man_function: Celestial intellect's dark counter — the corrupted reception in the cosmic figure.
title: Hyle as the Enthymesis of Death and how she molded the cosmos from herself
